stretches.quote: ##### There is an evaluation gap between performance in pre-deployment evaluations and in the real world
stretches.note: Section 3.1: the fullest statement. Evaluations are unreliable for capabilities and propensities; three limitations: (1) benchmarks fail to measure what they claim (shortcuts, opaque practices, dangerous-capability testing, sandbagging), (2) benchmark performance does not predict real-world behaviour (e.g. warm-tuned models 10-30 points more error-prone at similar benchmark scores), (3) pre-deployment testing cannot anticipate all failure modes.
